cases.name: mobile-en
cases.prompt: Write a short sick-leave email to my manager for today. Use placeholders instead of personal details.
cases.answer:
Here's a short sick-leave email you can adapt:

---

**Subject:** Sick Leave – [Your Name] – [Date]

Dear [Manager's Name],

I'm writing to let you know that I'm unwell today and won't be able to work. I'll be taking sick leave for [date] and will keep you updated on when I expect to return.

Please let me know if anything urgent needs my attention, and I'll do my best to respond when I'm able. Otherwise, I'll catch up on [key task/project] as soon as I'm back.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Contact Number]

---

Feel free to adjust the tone (more formal or more casual) or add details like who to contact in your absence.
